warnings: op1 direct read (house 13, Stage-2 SN-EE-M agent). LAST SHEET of the mechanical (M) set for this house -- M-02, 2/2 per M-01's sheet_total. MECHANICAL DISCIPLINE (M) COMPLETE.

*** CROSS-DISCIPLINE SPEC GAP, real and worth flagging: this floor's นอน 1 wall-type AC is rated 24,000 BTU, but EE-06's (page 64) AC circuit/wire-sizing table only lists rows for 'ไม่เกิน 12,000' (16AT) and 'ไม่เกิน 18,000' (20AT) BTU/hr -- no breaker/wire spec covers a 24,000 BTU unit anywhere in this drawing set. This mirrors a known gap already seen on a different house in this same government-standard series (a 24,000 BTU unit with no matching EE table row); confirmed here as a genuine, repeated defect in the source drawings, not a misreading on this house's part -- both figures (24,000 on this sheet, table capped at 18,000 on EE-06) were read directly and independently, not inferred from one another.

This floor carries all 3 of this house's wall-type AC units (12,000 + 12,000 + 24,000 BTU) and all 5 ceiling-fan/exhaust-grille pairs (40+40+120+80 CFM, one room -- นอน2 -- pairs its fan/grille with its own AC while ห้องน้ำ and นอน1 do too) -- the ground floor (M-01, page 65) has none of either, since all 3 bedrooms are upstairs.

Same faint/light-line-weight background overlay and the same unresolved grid dimension-chain caveat as M-01 (page 65) applies here -- see that file's warnings[] for the full explanation; grid_ref values are approximate room-based reads against the authoritative master, not derived from this sheet's own printed chain.

นอน 1's AC+fan+grille cluster is drawn away from the room's other electrical fixtures, close to the ระเบียง/กันสาด wall rather than centered in the room -- grid_ref reflects the fixture's actual drawn position (~B1, near the exterior wall) for the exhaust grille specifically, while the AC/fan pairing icons sit slightly further into the room (~C-A x 1-3).
